employees.evidence: but also on the talent of its people

dei.evidence: Ensuring that all voices are welcome and heard increases our awareness of what is possible.

integrity.evidence: Nothing is more important to our company than the privacy of our customers’ data.

innovation.evidence: Regularly providing new, innovative solutions gives our customers a competitive advantage.

result.analyst_notes: Aspirational, Trailblazer and Ohana-themed framing, with first-person plural 'we' throughout. Customers are addressed first and most often, with trust, innovation and equality as the four named core values. Commitments are often absolute ('Nothing is more important'), while equality and community appear only briefly. Recruiting prompts and testimonials are treated as chrome.
